sloka: आपतन्तं शरौघेण वारयामास राघवः ।उत्पतन्तं युगान्ताग्निं जलौघैरिव वासवः ।। ६.१०४.२३ ।।
transliteration: āpatantaṁ śaraugheṇa vārayāmāsa rāghavaḥ ।utpatantaṁ yugāntāgniṁ jalaughairiva vāsavaḥ ।। 6.104.23 ।।

translations.english: Raghava intercepted the trident, just as the fire was obstructed by the flow of water, at the time of universal dissolution, and obstructed.
